about: Fictional walkthrough seat (ops/make-demo-map.py). Not a real person.
name: Sam Rivera

map.title: Your map
map.law: Every step either clears a likely bottleneck or tells us more about one.

phases.label: Tell us more
phases.pace: A few minutes each; every answer sharpens the map

nodes.title: Get your applications in front of a person
nodes.why: Portal applications are skimmed by software and busy recruiters. A short note to the person hiring is read.

because: You've sent 76 to 200 applications and rarely hear back.

nodes.prepared: We find five fresh roles that fit you, the hiring manager for each, and a short note to each one in your voice.

tasks.title: Send the five notes from your own LinkedIn
tasks.changed: Five hiring managers now have a note from you, not only a portal application.

nodes.evidence: Five notes have gone to hiring managers.

nodes.title: Make your resume read like the role you want
nodes.why: A reader decides in a few seconds whether you fit. The first lines have to say the role and the proof.

because: Most replies depend on a quick skim of your resume, and right now those replies aren't coming.
In your resume, your bullet points describe your duties, not what changed because of your work.
In your resume, there are no numbers that show the impact of your work.

nodes.prepared: We rewrite your headline and the top of your resume from what you've told us, and flag any number we need you to confirm.

tasks.title: Confirm or correct the facts we flagged
tasks.done_when: Every flagged fact is confirmed or fixed.
tasks.changed: Every number in your new top lines is one you've checked.

tasks.title: Put the new top lines on your resume and LinkedIn
tasks.done_when: Your resume and LinkedIn show the new top lines.
tasks.changed: Your resume and LinkedIn now open with the role you want.

nodes.evidence: Your resume and LinkedIn lead with the role you want.

nodes.title: Show you can catch what AI gets wrong
nodes.why: Anyone can generate an app now. A dated audit of a real AI-built app, with the fixes, shows the judgment teams are hiring for, and a stranger can check it.

because: In your resume, there are no numbers that show the impact of your work.

nodes.prepared: We line up an AI-built app whose owner wants it checked, set up the introduction, and give you the audit checklist and a report outline.

tasks.title: Audit it against the checklist and fix the critical findings
tasks.done_when: Each critical finding is fixed and checked.
tasks.changed: A real AI-built app has a dated audit, with its critical findings fixed.

tasks.title: Publish the one-page audit report and link it at the top of your resume
tasks.done_when: The report is live and linked at the top of your resume.
tasks.changed: A reviewer can now open your audit from the top of your resume.

nodes.evidence: One verified audit is linked at the top of your resume.

nodes.title: Get your profile ready for the notes
nodes.why: While we work on the rest, this is the one thing that moves today. It takes about ten minutes, and only you can do it.

because: You've sent 76 to 200 applications and rarely hear back.

tasks.title: Change your LinkedIn headline so it names the role you want
tasks.done_when: Your headline names the role you want.
tasks.changed: A hiring manager who opens your profile from a note now reads the role you want first.

nodes.title: Goals and limits: 5 quick questions
nodes.why: Tell us what a good next job looks like for you, and what it can't cost you.

because: Answering opens up the roles to target.

nodes.title: Where it stops: 5 quick questions
nodes.why: Let's look at where your applications go and what comes back.

because: Answering opens up where to send applications.

tasks.title: Answer the 5 questions (about 2 min)
tasks.changed: Your search channels are on your map.

nodes.evidence: Your search channels are on your map.

nodes.title: Your presence: 6 quick questions
nodes.why: This is what a recruiter sees in their first seven seconds. We'll handle the rewriting and the design.

because: Answering opens up your LinkedIn, banner and photo.

tasks.title: Answer the 6 questions (about 3 min)
tasks.changed: We're preparing your profile now. A person will review it within 24 hours.

nodes.evidence: We're preparing your profile now. A person will review it within 24 hours.

nodes.title: Your proof: 5 quick questions
nodes.why: Let's look at the work you've shipped that someone else could open and check.

because: Answering opens up your proof and projects.

tasks.title: Answer the 5 questions (about 2 min)
tasks.changed: Your proof is on the map.

nodes.evidence: Your proof is on the map.

nodes.title: Your interviews: 2 quick questions
nodes.why: Tell us about the interviews you've had and where they ended.

because: Answering opens up interview prep for each company.

tasks.title: Answer the 2 questions (about 1 min)
tasks.changed: Your interview prep is on the map.

nodes.evidence: Your interview prep is on the map.

nodes.title: Your targets: 4 quick questions
nodes.why: Tell us where you'd like to work, and where you wouldn't.

because: Answering opens up outreach to your target companies.

nodes.title: Week one check-in
nodes.coming: One question about how your search feels, a week after you started.
nodes.why: A week in, one question. Your answer goes to Aden.

tasks.title: How do you feel about your search now?

fields.label: In a sentence or two, why
